scope: Independent full-case content acceptance of the indivisible training-only triplet

gates.sourceAndLevel: §4.5 connects process design with flow, cadence, control and its measured cost. Three teams and one planning period; Middle weighs fixed setup against recurring waiting costs. Values are scenario estimates.
gates.blind: A/B/C independently selected. Runners B, C, and a tie between B and D (both 100).
gates.family: Identical prompts, options, title and context except the late count sentence. Only n changes, 1/8/40. Four implementable, exclusive schemes; same reporting and checks.
gates.choiceAndScoring: A/B/C/D totals 10/22/53/100, 80/36/60/100, 400/100/92/100. Every pairwise partial grade follows cost, including TC-128 B=D.
gates.wholeOptionWhen: For integers 0–80: A uniquely cheapest at 0–2, B at 3–31, C at 33–47 and D at 49–80. Ties at 32 and 48 are correctly outside strict WHEN ranges.
gates.duplication: Allowed reinforcement of TC-076–078: there the residual defect risk changes optimal review intensity; here quality is constant and routing/latency determine the choice. TC-008/215/242/296 diagnose causal impact of a gate; here measurement already exists. TC-044/047/068/092/100/114/223/249/250/266 address different decisions.
gates.surface: Same neutral title, question and full answer strings across all three cases. Repetition exposes the intended mutation for training. No length or keyword singles out all keys.

importScope: Content accepted; working manifest integration/freeze and production regression are separate.
